name: L_3h
Description: Length of 3 hold structure

name: B
Description: Beam of Ship (although generated structure will be half beam)

name: T
Description: Draft of ship (not really used in the parameterization)

name: D
Description: Depth of ship

name: R_b
Description: Radius of Bilge

name: l_overhang
Description: fraction of L_3h that extends past the bulkeads at the end of the structure

name: Db
Description: height of double bottom

name: bottom shell thickness
Description: bottom shell thickness

name: side shell thickness
Description: side shell thickness

name: Inner Side Shell Thickness
Description: If less than 10 mm, set thickness to 0 -> no side wall

name: num bottom girders
Description: Number of girders between CL and edge of Web frames

name: num top girders
Description: Number of girders between CL and edge of Web frames

name: intermediate bottom stiffener h
Description: h - height of stiffener

name: intermediate bottom stiffener t
Description: t - plate thickness

name: intermediate bottom stiffener w
Description: w - width of flange

name: intermediate bottom stiffener torc
Description: boolean that controls if flange is a T of an L (mis-represented as 'C')

name: floor t
Description: Floors - transverse Beam that span the height of the double bottom

name: cat tanker
Description: controls if structure is 'tanker'

name: cat container
Description: controls if structure is 'container'

name: cat bulkcarrier
Description: controls if structure is 'bulk carrier'

name: floor web bracket L1
Description: Snap L1 to closest  inner bottom stiffener or Bottom Girder

name: floor web bracket L2
Description: Snap L2 to closest inner side shell long stiffener

name: deck web bracket L1
Description: Snap L1 to closest Deck Girder or Deck Stiffener

name: deck web bracket  L2
Description: Snap L2 to closest inner side shell long stiffener

name: cont step width
Notes: widths of 1 or 2 shipping containers + buffer

bulk car bottom hopper stiff h

bulk car bottom hopper stiff w

num intermediate trans frames
Description: number of frames between each web frame

Description: if there are hatch openings, there will be one centered in each hold.
